$comment: Image manifest. PLACEHOLDERS until the real product shoot: every image is an Instagram reel cover from @antlerteecreativestudios. To swap one, change `src` (or drop a new file in and point `src` at it), keep the `id`, then run `npm run images`. `src` is relative to `sourceRoot` (relative to this project folder). `aspect` is the crop (W:H). `focusY` picks the vertical crop position (0 = top, 0.5 = centre, 1 = bottom), used to cut baked-in caption text. Output: public/img/<id>-<width>.avif|webp plus src/content/images.generated.json.
